title: The Promise of Eden
summary: Jehovah's foundational Messianic prophecy spoken in Eden: the woman's offspring will permanently crush the serpent's head after suffering a temporary wound in the heel.
fulfillment: Fulfilled in Jesus Christ, who was struck in the heel through his death in 33 C.E. and resurrected to crush Satan.

title: Covenant with Abram
summary: Jehovah formalized his covenant with Abram, promising his offspring the land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates.
fulfillment: Established the legal territorial and spiritual inheritance for Abraham's descendants.

title: Abraham Given a New Name
summary: God renamed Abram ('Father Is High') to Abraham ('Father of a Crowd / Multitude'), declaring he would become the father of many nations.
fulfillment: Broadened the scope of God's promise beyond one household to encompass faithful people of all nations.

title: All Nations to Be Blessed
summary: After Abraham's extraordinary faith in offering Isaac, Jehovah swore by himself that through Abraham's offspring all nations of the earth would obtain a blessing.
fulfillment: Paul confirms at Galatians 3:16 that this promised 'offspring' is primarily Christ.

title: Promise to Isaac
summary: Jehovah confirmed the Abrahamic oath specifically through Isaac rather than Ishmael, narrowing the Messianic channel.
fulfillment: Verified that the covenant promise followed the miraculous line of Sarah's son Isaac.

title: Promise to Jacob
summary: In a dream at Bethel featuring angels ascending and descending to heaven, Jehovah confirmed to Jacob that all families of the ground would be blessed through his offspring.
fulfillment: Confirmed Jacob (not Esau) as the chosen third patriarch of the Messianic promise.

title: Jacob Renamed to Israel
summary: After persevering all night wrestling an angel at the Jabbok, Jacob was renamed Israel ('Contender With God'), naming the covenant nation.
fulfillment: Established the twelve tribes of Israel through which God's purpose would unfold.

title: The Tribe of Judah
summary: On his deathbed in Egypt, Jacob prophesied that the royal scepter would belong to Judah until 'Shiloh' ('He Whose It Is') arrives.
fulfillment: Narrowed the Messianic search from twelve tribes down to the single royal tribe of Judah.

title: The House of David
summary: Through the prophet Nathan, Jehovah promised King David an everlasting dynasty: his royal house and throne would stand firm forever.
fulfillment: Narrowed the Messiah's identity within Judah to a direct descendant of King David.

title: To the Manner of Melchizedek
summary: Jehovah swore that David's Lord would serve not only as King from Judah, but also as an eternal Priest 'in the manner of Melchizedek.'
fulfillment: Explains how Jesus from Judah holds a superior, permanent royal priesthood surpassing the Aaronic line.

title: Out of the Stump of Jesse
summary: Even after the royal Davidic tree would be cut down in Babylonian exile, 'the root of Jesse' would stand as a signal for the peoples and nations.
fulfillment: Foretold the Messiah's emergence from David's humble ancestral line in Bethlehem after centuries without a reigning king.

title: Messiah to Arrive in 69 'Weeks'
summary: Angel Gabriel revealed the 70-weeks prophecy: 69 prophetic weeks (483 years) from the word to rebuild Jerusalem (455 B.C.E.) would pinpoint the exact year Messiah the Leader would appear — 29 C.E.!
fulfillment: Pinpointed Jesus' baptism and anointing in the fall of 29 C.E. to the exact year.

title: Jesus to Inherit Throne of David
summary: Angel Gabriel declared to Mary in Nazareth: 'Jehovah God will give him the throne of David his father, and he will rule as King over the house of Jacob forever.'
fulfillment: Directly united the Genesis 3:15, Judah, and Davidic promises in Jesus of Nazareth.
